sources.quote: Compatible with PS3™ system software version 2.50 or later

notes: Sony's official CECHZC2E instruction manual (2012, English European issue), specifications and supplied-items sections on PDF page 2, fetched and visually checked on 2026-11-01. Mass 180 g and built-in rechargeable battery are printed explicitly. The controller-side connector is Mini-B (mini_usb) as indicated by the A–Mini-B charging cable; the manual names no other external interface. Wireless is explicit in the product name. The host key denotes the launch PS3; the manual supports PS3 systems with software 2.50 or later, not only that chassis. This regional suffix adds evidence for CECHZC2E; no claim of a new shell dimension is made. No body dimensions, complete control list, cable length or exact release day appears here, so those values remain null or uncovered. Sony's 2007-09-20 press release was also inspected, but its announced November launch is not an exact release date. Earlier unsuccessful third-party/Wayback searches have been superseded by this maker-hosted PDF.
